title: Chaalchitro: The Ekchala Murders Trailer Out: Tota, Anirban C, Chanchal C
excerpt: Official trailer for Chaalchitro: The Ekchala Murders — premieres Dec 4, 2026.
body:
• The trailer for Chaalchitro: The Ekchala Murders dropped November 24, 2026.
  • New Bengali series premiering Dec 4, 2026 on Hoichoi.

The makers of Chaalchitro: The Ekchala Murders have released the official trailer, unveiled November 24, 2026.

For diaspora audiences tracking the series's US release, the trailer is the first real look at what's headed to Hoichoi.
